description_en: Creates a trace evaluation task. The system will sample some data from the user's trace data based on the task's configuration. Then, an LLM is used to evaluate the performance of these traces, and the evaluation results are recorded
description_zh: 创建一个链路评估任务。系统会根据任务配置，从用户的链路数据里采样部分数据，用大模型对这些链路的执行效果做评估，并记录评估结果
